mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (name, student_no, age, major, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{name}, #{studentNo}, #{age}, #{major}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET name = #{name}, age = #{age}, major = #{major}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM student WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM student WHERE student_no = #{studentNo} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM student WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.student_no, s.age, s.major, s.create_time, s.update_time, lc.id as card_id, lc.card_no, lc.issue_date, lc.expire_date, lc.status as card_status, bb.id as borrow_id, bb.borrow_date, bb.return_date, bb.status as borrow_status, b.id as book_id, b.book_name, b.author, b.isbn, sc.id as sc_id, sc.enroll_date, sc.score, c.id as course_id, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credits, c.teacher FROM student s LEFT JOIN library_card lc ON s.id = lc.student_id AND lc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN book_borrow bb ON s.id = bb.student_id AND bb.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN book b ON bb.book_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_course sc ON s.id = sc.student_id AND sc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0

SELECT * FROM student WHERE deleted = 0
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
AND major LIKE CONCAT('%', #{major}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.student_no, s.age, s.major, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.deleted FROM student s INNER JOIN student_course sc ON s.id = sc.student_id AND sc.deleted = 0 WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId} AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY sc.enroll_date DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE deleted = 0
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
AND major LIKE CONCAT('%', #{major}, '%')
